evidence_items.explanation: The best overall mean is 80.6% with 30 examples; Section 4.1 reports near-zero or decreasing slopes for many families, with only Cohere, T0 and InstructGPT-3 performing best at their largest tested size. The same source qualifies the headline: structured prompts average 81.7%, and Table 58 includes an individual-template score of 82.8%.
